name: The Road to Darnassus
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The road to Darnassus must be kept safe.  Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.

Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily.  We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.

Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, champion.  Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point.  Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
narrative.objectives: Slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to Sentinel Amara Nightwalker outside of Dolanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave Champion. As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
narrative.requestItemsText: The road is still not safe, champion. Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.
